title: Rory and the Moonlit Cove
verses:
The blue sky was fading as shadows grew long,
And Nia flew high with a soft bedtime song.
Then Rory walked slowly down to the bright cove,
Where sweet silver blossoms bloomed deep in the grove.

Then Benny sat down by the calm waterfall,
And Tilly hummed low to befriend one and all.
While Ricky stopped running to look at the stream,
And Psittaco chirped of a wonderful dream.

The tiny tidepools were beginning to glow,
As waves on the sand started rocking so slow.
And Rory looked out at the twinkling sea,
As sleepy and safe as a dino could be.

Then Psittaco tucked right inside a warm leaf,
And Ricky lay down on a soft mossy reef.
And Nia brushed down with her wings folded tight,
To whisper to Rory a cozy goodnight.

Then Tilly rested her chin on the ground,
While Benny gave out a soft, sleepy sound.
And Rory snuggled right into the sand,
While moonlight washed over the peaceful green land.

The stars shone so bright in the magical sky,
As waves sang a slow and sweet lullaby.
Now Rory is sleeping and snoring so soft,
While dreams carry everyone gently aloft.
